fields.statement: In an autonomous run, a PreToolUse hook on AskUserQuestion denies the call, records the question as a question node, and tells the session its answer will arrive as a message, so the session's turn ends at its prompt; once the arbiter's Decision answers the question, the engine delivers it with rhiza session message. Nothing is typed into a menu, and no hook waits on the arbiter.
fields.wording: the orchestrator's ruling as arbiter, under the owner's instruction to be the arbiter (milestone-3 conversation); not the owner's words
